display_name: 独立学生复数滤波 GPU 训练
description: 冻结源域独立恢复学生，用接收 IQ 预测 17 抽头复数滤波残差；GPU 预计算学生输出并复用。

data.representation: paired received/clean source IQ and frozen DURA source IQ teacher

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-only 20-epoch wide independent student, frozen; zero-initialized new 17-tap complex FIR head
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed parent commit, no F/TX/V/target and matching ordered 32768 source IDs; DURA source-only IQ teacher
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source-only direct student and DURA use matching source IQ roles; no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed incremental final epoch 5; no target or pilot score selection

rows.method: Frozen wide direct student with received-IQ-conditioned complex 17-tap residual
rows.purpose: Learn a source-IQ FIR correction and reuse frozen student outputs for faster GPU training
rows.seed_notes: FIR initialization 2026110612; source IDs 2026110611; source order 2026110613; evaluation 2026092701

notes: Frozen source student never sees F, TX labels, V or target; DURA is used only as frozen source-IQ teacher.
Fixed source cache has matching ordered 32768 fit IDs x three views; student forward precomputed once and reused for five epochs.
No clean reference, teacher, target fitting or ground labels at deployed inference.
Local RTX 5070 Ti 192-record five-epoch benchmark includes precompute: 0.4024944 s uncached vs 0.2600635 s cached; identical losses and parameters; not a full [计算环境] measurement.
Inherited student 20 epochs plus 5 incremental epochs; final checkpoint fixed before ground tests.
168000 physical records x seven Phase1 ground views with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; truth only after all predictions; compare paired DURA and raw clean.
GPU5 queue waits while three compute apps exist or free memory below 4096 MiB; other jobs are untouched.
